request.prompt: Create a NEW dedicated MYTHIC-BOSS-quality hand-painted dark fantasy isometric RPG animation source for ALBINO DEMON, matching the supplied exact existing project reference. No wings, shield or extra arms. Anatomical RIGHT hand grips ONE enormous iron crescent AXE on a long wood shaft; anatomical LEFT clawed hand is empty. Preserve boss-specific armor, skull belt, axe proportions, both horns and limb identity in all figures. Original detailed painted sprites, NOT a recolored existing rig, no lava or fist-golem shape. Orthographic elevated camera at 35 degrees. This sheet is TRUE EAST side view: face/chest/toes and axe strike point toward screen RIGHT, no front-facing angle. EXACTLY SEVEN complete separate connected character figures in ONE column and SEVEN equally spaced rows, ordered top to bottom: row0 IDLE neutral broad weighted stance, right axe head low-forward, left hand half-open; row1 IDLE inhale chest/shoulders lift subtly, head tilts and left fingers flex, planted soles; row2 ATTACK WINDUP deep knees/hips load, torso twists back and RIGHT elbow pulls axe back behind right shoulder, both feet braced; row3 ATTACK CONTACT right-handed horizontal cleave, blade unmistakably projects FORWARD toward screen RIGHT ahead of head at enemy chest height, front foot planted with hips driving weight into strike, left EMPTY hand counterbalances; row4 ATTACK RECOVERY heavy axe follow-through dips forward, right elbow bends back and torso untwists, weight settles; row5 HIT RECOIL chest snaps back, head recoils and knees compress, right axe defensively across hip, left fingers spread; row6 HIT RECOVERY low braced stagger with different torso/leg pose, gaze forward, axe lowered. Specific articulated limb, hip, shoulder and axe movement rather than whole-body translation/rotation. Every axe shaft remains touching the RIGHT gripping hand. Entire horns, weapon, tail, claws and chains inside the CENTER FORTY PERCENT of each row band, enormous clean transparent gaps, figure small enough never to enter another row's axis-aligned bounding rectangle. Tall spacious portrait sheet. ONE solid connected silhouette per figure, no detached floor/shadow/particles/glow/debris/specks. TRUE transparent alpha background, no text/grid/labels/platform.
